candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming ether amount from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering whether require passes and thus whether state updates and potential transfers occur.
Remove the time-order check so fallback no longer requires block.timestamp to increase, changing when pastBlockTime is updated.
Update pastBlockTime before checking the timestamp, causing the require to potentially fail and changing observable behavior.
Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when funds are sent and thus observable state.
Replace transfer with sending zero value (no-op) so balance no longer forwarded, changing observable contract balance after fallback.
